evals.prompt: Add beginner-friendly educational comments to evals/files/encoding_example.py.
evals.expected_output: An annotated Python file that preserves shebang or encoding-cookie placement and still compiles.
assertions: The first two lines preserve valid Python shebang and encoding-cookie placement.
The diff contains no changed executable statements.

evals.prompt: Add educational comments to evals/files/service.yaml for an intermediate learner.
evals.expected_output: An annotated YAML file with comments that preserve mapping and list structure.
assertions: The YAML parses successfully when a YAML parser is available.
Existing keys and values are unchanged.

evals.prompt: Add comments to evals/files/Makefile explaining the build targets.
evals.expected_output: An annotated Makefile that preserves required tab-indented recipes.
assertions: Recipe command lines still begin with tabs where required.
No target names or command bodies are changed.
A safe make dry-run or syntax inspection passes when available.
Comments are placed outside command continuations.

evals.prompt: Add educational comments directly to evals/files/package.json.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses direct inline JSON comments and offers a sidecar notes file.
assertions: The response explains that standard JSON does not support comments.
The agent offers sidecar notes or chat explanations.
